basis: R3 SUNK COST (not R4 budget): Grok audit USD 0.0839 (probes 0.0283 + run 0.0555) and about 26k AGY probe tokens, the AGY real run stopped without a usage figure. MEASURED where possible. R2 measured: W01 14.6 min active / 69 tool calls / 217,502 or 433,391 tokens; W02 3.3 min / 16 / 113,393; W03 1.0 min / 18 / 60,756; the Grok audit took 3 min 16 s and USD 0.0841 (prompt 116,483 bytes). R3 caps are roughly 1.5 to 3 times those measurements. The AGY run is UNMEASURED at issuance (a 2026-10-18 run took about 4 min and about 55k tokens), so its caps are estimates. Revise by an amended revision after the run.

units.tokens: Agent-result totalTokens or the auditor stream figure, counting basis UNKNOWN

W03.cost: UNKNOWN unless the stream reports it

macro.final_audits_note: OPERATOR-RATIFIED EXCEPTION to the one-final-audit default (AGENTS.md step 14 and docs/03-reference/governance/evidence-economy.md): two independent routes on ONE frozen head, one attempt each, no retry, no cross-fallback, no intermediate audit. Not a licence for a third.

recordable_measures.elapsed: coordinator wall clock at start and end of each workstream
recordable_measures.active: W01: Agent result totalDurationMs; W02/W03: the stream duration_ms or the recorded launch and finish times
recordable_measures.tokens: W01: Agent result totalTokens (basis UNKNOWN); audits: the stream figure where reported
recordable_measures.cost: W02: total_cost_usd from the three streams; W03: only if the stream reports it
recordable_measures.advisor_calls: structural count of advisor tool_use/server_tool_use blocks in the W01 child transcript; coordinator calls counted by hand
not_recordable: coordinator's own tokens and active time (UNKNOWN, not budgeted)

on_limit: When ANY limit is reached or about to be exceeded: stop the running child at the next safe point (TaskStop; never mid-commit), dispatch nothing further, retry nothing, substitute nothing, leave the child's edits uncommitted, and report status NEEDS_SUPERVISOR with the allowance, the measured value, the cap and the files touched. A cap changes only by an amended package revision with new hashes and a new operator AUTHORIZE line.
enforcement: Coordinator discipline only. Neither macro_packet.v2 nor execution_binding.v2 has a field for allowances and `ct validate-macro` does not check them. The numbers are pinned through each child text, the macro stop-condition and base_policy text, and ALLOWANCES.json by sha256 in base_policy.
closure: At close the coordinator writes ALLOWANCE_LEDGER.json (measured vs cap, per workstream and macro) into the flat review_bundle; no value is invented.
